description: This file contains implementation of functions related to the 'Ansc Module Container Object' for the Advanced Networking Service Container (ANSC). It defines functions for engaging, canceling, igniting, putting out, and switching the module. The code includes licensing information and references to global headers, but no class or method definitions are detailed beyond these operational functions.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscMcoSubEngage(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Engages the container operations by creating or retrieving the query interface object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscMcoSubCancel(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cancels the container operations by removing the query interface object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscMcoIgnite(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Prepares the module for operation; currently a placeholder returning success.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscMcoPutOut(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up or halts the module; currently a placeholder returning success.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscMcoSwitch(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOL bSwitchOn)
methods.description: Toggles the module state on or off; currently a placeholder returning success.
